shortBio.en: Talking Heads frontman; angular guitar, nervous baritone, Eno-era polyrhythm vocals.
shortBio.zh: Talking Heads 主唱；棱角吉他、紧张男中音、Eno 时期多节奏人声。

body.en:
Born 1952. CBGB art-punk to Remain in Light (1980) with Eno. Stop Making Sense locks big-suit stage grammar.

Post-Heads solo and soundtrack work; Heads catalog remains the citation.
body.zh:
1952 年生。从 CBGB 艺术朋克到与 Eno 的 Remain in Light（1980）。Stop Making Sense 锁死大西装舞台语法。

Heads 后独唱与配乐；Heads 目录仍是引用。
